thread:
maria: Heads-up — saw a spike in kernel fallback rate this morning. Many H100 shards started using generic_slow_kernel for seq_len ~256-512. QPS dropped ~18% in the affected pool.
kevin: ugh. can you paste the pick debug output + env flags?
maria: pasted below. this is one example from a single request: 
```
[2026-03-12T15:02:01Z] pick: model=starfire-7b arch=h100 seq_len=320 prefix_len=64 kv_effective_len=384
 available_kernels=[amx_fused_fp16, vectorized_fp16, generic_slow_kernel]
 chosen=generic_slow_kernel reason="fallback:autotune_miss; score_amx=1.2 score_vec=0.8 score_generic=-5.3"
flags: RUNTIME_PICK_TRACE=1 RUNTIME_KERNEL_TELEMETRY=1 AUTOTUNE_MODE=online
```
maria: env we set for the pool: `AUTOTUNE_SEED=1`, `FORCE_QUANT_PROFILE=auto`, nothing else special.
ops-bot: alert: kernel_fallback_rate(us-west-2, starfire-7b) +12% over baseline in last 30m :warning:
alex: saw a similar blip last night in canary, but it recovered after a restart. hypothesis: effective seq_len bumped (prefix caching change) and autotuner didn't have a warm profile for that bucket.
jin: worth checking KV cache behavior — if prefix caching started keeping long histories, effective sequence grows and pushes selection into a different decision path. did you see kv_effective_len in the logs?
maria: yes kv_effective_len=384 in example. app team rolled out sticky convo caching yesterday so looks correlated.
kevin: two immediate actions: 1) add more explanatory telemetry fields (effective_seq_bucket, autotune_status, score_breakdown). 2) short-term: set kernel_override=vectorized_fp16 for that model in the affected pool to restore throughput.
alex: repro notes I ran locally with H100 container: 
```
# run with pick tracing
RUNTIME_PICK_TRACE=1 RUNTIME_KERNEL_TELEMETRY=1 ./runtime --model starfire-7b --seq 384 --prefix 64
# output (truncated)
pick_scores: {amx_fused_fp16: 1.2, vectorized_fp16: 0.8, generic_slow_kernel: -5.3}
autotune_state: bucket=256-512 seed=empty fallback=true
chosen=generic_slow_kernel reason=fallback_due_to_empty_autotune_profile
```
alex: once I populated a small autotune sample for that bucket, pick switched back to vectorized_fp16 and QPS improved.
jin: so root cause = new request shape + cold autotune bucket. we should expose "bucket_fill_pct" in telemetry and a policy to prefer arch-native kernels if autotune is cold.
kevin: agree. I'll open a small patch: 1) telemetry additions 2) policy opt-in 'prefer_arch_fastpath_when_cold' 3) add an internal metric autotune_cold_rate per bucket.
maria: deploying a hotfix: set `kernel_override=vectorized_fp16` on the us-west-2 starfire pool and bump metric retention so we can validate.
ops-bot: action logged: set pool policy starfire-usw2 kernel_override=vectorized_fp16 by maria at 2026-03-12T15:03:22Z
maria: after override, fallback rate dropped back to baseline in 3 minutes. will follow up with a patch for telemetry + policy.
kevin: for postmortem, add a timestamped example event in telemetry so we can replay decisions in the eval harness. also add a quick script to synthesize warm autotune samples for new prefix lengths.
maria: noted. thanks all. closing thread after the patch lands. :thumbsup:
